description: This source file implements media streaming and playback functionalities for Android, including classes for stream sources, media player client, and main application logic for handling video playback with surface creation and file processing.

classes.name: MyStreamSource
classes.description: Handles streaming data from a file descriptor, manages buffer queuing, and communicates with a stream listener.

classes.name: MyConvertingStreamSource
classes.description: Converts media files into transport stream format, manages buffer writing, and signals end-of-stream.

classes.name: MyClient
classes.description: Media player client that waits for playback completion or errors.

methods.name: MyStreamSource::MyStreamSource
methods.description: Constructor initializing stream source with file descriptor.

methods.name: MyStreamSource::onBufferAvailable
methods.description: Reads data into buffer when buffer is available.

methods.name: MyConvertingStreamSource::MyConvertingStreamSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes media extraction and MPEG2TSWriter.

methods.name: MyConvertingStreamSource::writeData
methods.description: Writes data into buffers, signals end-of-stream.

methods.name: MyConvertingStreamSource::onBufferAvailable
methods.description: Handles buffer availability, signals end-of-stream if reached.

methods.name: MyClient::notify
methods.description: Handles media error or completion notifications.

methods.name: MyClient::waitForEOS
methods.description: Waits until end of stream or error.
